children: On September 15, 2026, Nasdaq staff notified the company that its common stock is subject to delisting from the Nasdaq Global Market after it failed to regain compliance with the $1.00 minimum bid price under Listing Rule 5450(a)(1) by the September 14 deadline. The company will request a hearing, which stays any delisting, and it has filed a proxy to seek approval for a 1-for-5 to 1-for-15 reverse stock split to help regain compliance.
